Pre-qualification Criteria: 1) Past work experience: 1.1 The bidder must have successfully completed similar work(s) during the las t 7 years ending last day of month previous to the one in which tender is float ed/issued. The similar work experience must satisfy both of the following technical require ments a) Equipment Replacement: Successful execution of a job involving th e replacement of at least one single process equipment (e.g., Exchang er, Pump, Compressor, or equivalent) with a minimum weight of 8 Me tric Tons (MT). b) Specialized Welding: Successful execution of pressure piping weldi ng involving a minimum thickness of 8 mm utilizing any of the followin g Materials of Construction (MOC): i) Inconel / High Nickel Alloy (Ni > 25%), ii) Stainless Steel (SS) iii) Carbon Steel (CS), iv) Low-Temperature Carbon Steel (LTCS) c) Against above experience criteria, bidders may submit either a single integrated Work Order covering both a) and b) OR separate Work Orde rs for each a) and b). d) The submitted work orders should be issued & executed during the la st seven years ending the last day of month previous to the one in whi ch this subject tender is floated/issued. e) All submitted Work Orders, along with their respective completion pro of, must be explicitly issued by companies operating in India within the following sectors: i) Fertilizer Plants, ii) Petrochemical Industries. iii) Power Plants iv) Stee l Industries. v) Dept. of Atomic Energy units (eg. HWP, NPCIL, NRB, BAR C, NFC etc). vi) Government of India Undertakings (PSUs). Proof of execution of submitted work order, which may include any of the following (i) Completion Certificate / Customer Acceptance Certificate OR (ii) GeM SDAC (Service Delivery and Acceptance Certificate) document OR (iii) (a) Tax Invoice to the extent of the required Pre-Qualification value and (b) Proof of receipt of payment like bank statement for the abov e referred tax

1.2 Sub contract work order shall not be considered for Prequalification. 2) Average annual financial turnover during the last three years, ending 31st March of the financial year (i.e. FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26) should be a t least Rs. 3.73 Lakhs. In case the date of constitution/incorporation of the bidder is less than three yea rs old, the average annual financial turnover in respect of the completed financi al years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account. In this case, t he financial turnover during last financial year/ the average financial turnover d uring preceding two financial years should be at least Rs. 3.73 Lakhs. Bidders shall submit CA certificate / CA audited Profit & Loss accounts, Balance sheets etc. indicating the annual turnover figures, in support of the same. The fi nancial documents has to be CA audited/issued with membership number, seal, signed and with UDIN. 3) Ownership of company with name, addresses and telephone nos. of proprieto rs/ partners/directors. 4) Copy of Partnership deed /proprietorship/ Memorandum and article of associa tion and certificate of incorporation as the case may be. 5) Shall submit Provident Fund Registration details, ESIC regis tration details, PAN details and GST details.
